evidence.reason: The finding targets the stale `modelUsageEntryFromWire` shaped check that accepted non-numeric token fields and zero-filled them. Commit e58894dcc23564e39220fec93013bd80024d0269 ("fail loud on unpriced models, invalid budgets and malformed modelUsage") changes malformed `modelUsage` handling so an invalid entry no longer silently wins with an all-zero fold. The alleged silent suppression is therefore addressed at the pinned tip.
